title.zh: Gemini创始人兄弟与DCG创始人加码布局Zcash，竞逐矿业与ETF市场
title.en: Gemini创始人兄弟与DCG创始人加码布局Zcash，竞逐矿业与ETF市场

current_state.zh: Cypherpunk Technologies, which is backed by the Winklevoss brothers, and Fortitude Mining, which is backed by DCG's Barry Silbert, have each become major Zcash miners and are each approaching roughly 20% of network hashrate, and they are expanding with tens of millions of dollars in new equipment while competing on Zcash ETF products.
current_state.en: Cypherpunk Technologies, which is backed by the Winklevoss brothers, and Fortitude Mining, which is backed by DCG's Barry Silbert, have each become major Zcash miners and are each approaching roughly 20% of network hashrate, and they are expanding with tens of millions of dollars in new equipment while competing on Zcash ETF products.
